clips.text: Hello. I'm Peter. I read every pixel reel out loud, so you don't have to.
I should be honest with you. I'm a computer voice, built from old audiobook readings that belong to everyone.
It means I never get tired, and I'm never in a rush. Play me again as often as you like.
And there's only me. Pixel Reel can't be made to sound like anybody else. Which I find rather reassuring.
